title: UI refinements: remove “Studio Art Engine”, round main Preview image corners, and shrink Forge token preview

requirements.text: Remove the text label "Studio Art Engine" everywhere it appears in the UI, including the dashboard header branding and the browser document title.
acceptanceCriteria: When no project is selected (Dashboard view), the header does not display "Studio Art Engine".
The HTML document <title> no longer contains "Studio Art Engine".
No other visible UI element contains the exact text "Studio Art Engine".

requirements.text: Apply rounded corners only to the main NFT preview image on the Preview page (the large central preview), without changing corner styling for other NFT images elsewhere in the app.

quotes: 2. only the main preview shown in image 1

acceptanceCriteria: On the Preview page, the rendered NFT preview (canvas/image area) has visibly rounded corners.
NFT images/previews in other areas (e.g., Vault grid, Forge tokens grid) do not change corner radius as part of this requirement.

requirements.text: On the Forge (Builder) page, make the forged token NFT preview image smaller within each forged token card while keeping the card layout intact.

quotes: 3. the NFT preview itself ( attact image)

acceptanceCriteria: In the "FORGED TOKENS" grid on the Forge page, each token image renders smaller than before (e.g., with padding/margins inside the square preview area), matching the intent of the provided reference.
Token image aspect ratio is preserved and remains centered within its preview area.
No functional behavior changes to forged token actions (e.g., delete).

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn components are read-only).
Do not edit immutable hook files listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (use composition/wrappers if needed).
Backend schema/state must not change (UI-only update).
nonGoals: Changing rounded corners for all NFT images globally.
Altering Forge/Vault generation logic, metadata, or storage behavior.
Introducing new navigation items or redesigning layouts beyond the specified tweaks.
